purpose: Keep the execution core independent of any specific AI platform or connected application.
adapter_rules: The harness owns reasoning, routing, authority and QA. Adapters only expose system capabilities.
An adapter must never elevate its own defaults above GreenSquare doctrine.
Writes require an authority decision before invocation.
Every write must return a traceable identifier, location or error.
If an adapter cannot verify success, record the action as blocked or uncertain rather than successful.

external_write_policy.AUTONOMOUS: allowed when low consequence, reversible and within explicit workflow intent
external_write_policy.ESCALATE: blocked pending human judgment for the consequential element
